# Brushwork calibration pictures

512 px close-ups for `tests/style-distance.test.ts` and `tests/brushwork-score.test.ts`, cut from Edgar Degas, *Woman
with a Towel* (1894 or 1898, pastel), The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access (public domain), object 436128.

- `pastel-real.png`, `pastel-real-other-spot.png`: two spots of the museum's full-size image, side by side.
- `pastel-sharpened.png`: the first spot from a quarter-size JPEG copy enlarged 4x by Real-ESRGAN x4plus.
- `pastel-dabbed.png`: the first spot repainted as uniform small soft dabs of the local colour (a stand-in for a
  reference transfer, made for the trial of 2026-11-15; not a Toska painting).
